name: infographic-studio
description: Compose reviewed infographics and diagrams with editable labels and SVG, PNG and PDF exports.

interface.shortDescription: Reviewed infographics and diagrams with editable labels.
interface.longDescription: Turn technical content into editable infographic and diagram scenes, combine vector artwork with local illustrations, check typography and export figures offline.
defaultPrompt: Create a reviewed infographic or diagram with editable labels. Establish art direction and a composition that explains the idea; do not default to an icon row.
